notes.title: Goodbye Gutwhale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This post marks the end of work on Gutwhale! 
While you can find a more in depth post-mortem from my developer side [url=http://stuffedwomb.at/goodbye_gutwhale]here[/url], this text is about the future of Gutwhale on Steam!

To make it short:

- Gutwhale will get no future updates on steam
- we have been unable to get achievements working
- the faulty control texts are fixed
- the savegame issues have been fixed
- we still do not know for sure why some controllers do not work

[b]Steam does not automatically update your version of Gutwhale. If you want to get all the fixes & updates we have done, you need to reinstall the game.[/b]

We want to thank you all for your great feedback and suggestions. They are really appreciated and I truly wish I could have implemented some of them.

The short development time of Gutwhale created horrible code that is very hard to modify, as well as a pretty intense burnout/recovery period for me.
In addition to that, the steamworks plugins for the engine I used are no longer supported and we could not get complete steamworks integration running, meaning that we could not add steam achievements. This is probably also causing the controller issues, but we do not know.

I am very sorry that I could not give Gutwhale the support it needed as fast as you demanded it. I have learned my lesson and will give myself more time for future releases, so I do not need a month of recovery after release. I have also upgraded to the newest version of my engine, which should take care of all the Steamworks issues we had with Gutwhale.


Making Gutwhale in one month was an amazing experience. It was made way too fast and has problems that we can not fix because of that. We will give ourself more time to make the next game, both for our sake as well as for yours.

We all want to thank you for playing our game and hope that you enjoyed it.

Cheers,
Josh

notes.title: Gutwhale - first update
notes.content:
Heyo :)

Tthe first update for Gutwhale has just been published!
I hope that steam will automatically update your game, but if you do not see a new loading screen when booting up the game, you have to quickly reinstall Gutwhale :/

This is just a small quality of life update, containing the following things:

[list]
[*] Savegame issue fixed
[*] Achievement room unlock issue fixed
[*] Restarting now resets combo, hat & score
[*] Added quick restart button (R on keyboard / Y on controller)
[*] Fixed wrong text on restarting with controller
[*] Added Dpad support to menu
[*] Added combosystem to nightmare mode
[/list]

Now I will focus on the bigger tech tasks, such as getting Gutwhale to run reliably on Linux & Max, fixing the arcane controller problem & trying to get steam achievements and cloud save to work!

I am not a good coder, so some of these might not work out or may take some time!


For the new content we have been thinking hard and will probably expand the nightmare world to have its own hat unlock system and its own store as well as Bossfights!

Nothing set in stone there though :)

Thank you for you continued support and have a nice day!

Cheers,
josh

notes.title: The Future of Gutwhale! - Post Release Roadmap
notes.content:
Heyo!

Gutwhale has released and it has been amazing!
Thank you to everyone who played it, we are really happy that you seem to enjoy it and thank you so much for your 100% positive ratings :O

We have recieved a lot of feedback and after sifting through all of it, i am proud to present the roadmap for my continued work on Gutwhale!

[u][b]First, I am going to polish the current version up:[/b][/u]

- I am going to fix many of the little bugs and exploits that do not break the game but are a bit annoying.
- I am going to fix some small issues related to the games saving system
- I am going to rework the endgame content, so that it has more features for people who have beaten the complete game and are now competing for highscores and speedruns!

[u][b]
Then, I am going to attempt some backend coding things[/b][/u]

- I will try my best to add steam achievements to Gutwhale
- I will research this one weird controller issue where new Xbox controllers do not get recognised by the game
- I will try to get Linux and Mac version running on Steam
[u]
[b]Eventually, we will look into making new content for Gutwhale![/b][/u]

Some of you have beaten the game much, much faster than we anticipated and we want to add some hard challenges for you!

Right now I am thinkign about adding a Loop-System, where you can restart a run, but keep your score!
There might also be a way to create one infinitely long level, but I will have to look into that :)
And maybe we could add the bossfight that was cut for time back into Gutwhale?

If you have any suggestions for hard endgame content, please do not be shy and just tell us :)


While doing all of this, I will spend half of my time on marketing Gutwhale. I am going to go on some podcasts and streams and send a lot of emails!
We are also going to finally publish the development logs, as well as a video about how the game evolved visually!

If you have any questions, requests or want to report any bugs, please let us know on the discussion page!
And again, thank you all so much for playing our little game :))

cheers,
josh
